name: io.github.Cora77-ops/kingy-facts
title: Kingy AI Facts
description: Dated, sourced AI facts from Kingy AI: prices, bills, plans, limits, deadlines, launches, changes.

tools.name: get_model_prices
tools.description: Current per-token API prices for AI models, with context limits and official sources. The reviewed set (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) is human-reviewed and re-verified every few hours; the extended set (other providers) is parsed automatically from official pricing pages and marked verification "automated-page-parse". Only rows with state "current" have a confirmed price; held or expired rows show none.

model.description: Model id or name, e.g. gpt-5.4 or "Claude Opus 5.5". Omit to list all.

provider.description: Provider name, e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek.

current_only.description: Return only rows with a currently confirmed price.

include_automated_parse.description: Include extended providers parsed automatically from official pages (verification "automated-page-parse"). Default true.

tools.name: estimate_api_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of a workload (tokens per request times requests) on up to six models using Kingy's currently verified standard rates. Applies long-context tiers; models without a current verified price are listed as unavailable with the reason.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens per request, including any cached input.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens per request, including reasoning tokens.

cached_input_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache. Default 0.

tools.name: compare_subscription_plans
tools.description: US prices, features and conditions for consumer AI subscriptions (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini/Google AI, Copilot), each with its price check date and official sources.

provider.description: Provider, e.g. openai, anthropic, google, github.

max_monthly_usd.description: Only plans at or below this monthly price (annual plans use their monthly equivalent).

feature.description: Only plans with documented access to this feature id, e.g. web-search, deep-research, image-generation, video-generation, coding-agent, terminal-coding, api-access.

tools.name: get_usage_limits
tools.description: Documented usage limits (messages, credits, rate limits, reset windows) for AI products and plans such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Perplexity, Midjourney and the major APIs, with review status and source. Call with no product to list covered products.

product.description: Product id or name, e.g. claude, copilot, openai-api.

plan.description: Plan name filter, e.g. Pro, Plus, Free.

tools.name: check_model_access
tools.description: Kingy Can I Use: whether a specific model can be used for a purpose, through a route (direct API, third-party provider or open weights), in a jurisdiction (US, Canada, EU, UK). Returns yes, conditional, no or unknown with availability, licence, contract and regulatory dimensions and sources. Not legal advice.

model.description: Model id or name, e.g. gpt-5.4, kimi-k3, claude-sonnet-4.6.

tools.name: find_model_changes
tools.description: Reviewed AI platform changes from official vendor sources: model retirements and deprecations, breaking API changes, migration deadlines, access and price changes, each with the affected model ids, deadline, required action and sources. Use it to check whether a model id in your code is being retired.

query.description: Model id, product or keyword, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5, Assistants API, gemini 2.5.

status.description: "open" means upcoming or active. Default any.

tools.name: can_i_run_locally
tools.description: Kingy's verdict on running a model on your own hardware: Yes, Yes but slow, Barely, No or Not tested yet, per machine type (8GB GPU PC or laptop, 16GB laptop, 24GB Mac, 24GB or 32GB GPU PC, 64GB Mac, 128GB Mac or Strix Halo, 512GB Mac Studio). Each verdict names the exact file and format, the runtime, the speed, and whether Kingy measured it, a third party reported it, or it is estimated.

model.description: Model id or name, e.g. qwen3.8-27b or "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash".

machine.description: One machine type. Omit for all.

tools.name: list_ai_shutdowns
tools.description: The Kingy AI Graveyard: dated shutdowns of AI tools, retirements of AI models and business transitions, with citations and alternatives Kingy reviewed.

query.description: Name or keyword, e.g. Humane, Sora.

tools.name: search_kingy
tools.description: Search kingy.ai articles, original tests, comparisons and tools. Returns titles, URLs, dates and short excerpts.

tools.name: what_changed_since
tools.description: Every recorded change across Kingy's datasets since a date: API price and spec changes, usage-limit and plan changes, new or updated shutdowns and retirement deadlines, new launches, and reviewed retirements or breaking changes. Each event has before/after values, the Kingy page and the official source. Use it to catch up or to poll.

since.description: Date (UTC) written as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-01. Events on or after this date.

datasets.description: Limit to these datasets. Default all.

include_verification_states.description: Also return price verification state flips (current/held). Default false.

tools.name: estimate_monthly_bill
tools.description: Turn a daily usage pattern (requests per day, tokens per request) into a cost per day and per period for up to six models, using Kingy's currently verified rates. Models without a current price are listed as unavailable with the reason.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens per request, including any cached input.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens per request, including reasoning tokens.

cached_input_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache. Default 0.

tools.name: find_models_that_fit
tools.description: Filter currently priced models by maximum input or output price (USD per 1M tokens), minimum context window, minimum output tokens, provider, or a Kingy home-hardware verdict, sorted by price or context. Facts only: it does not rank quality.

min_context_window.description: Smallest acceptable context window in tokens.

min_output_tokens.description: Smallest acceptable maximum output per request.

must_run_on.description: Only models with a Kingy "Yes" or "Yes, but slow" verdict for this machine type.

include_automated_parse.description: Include extended providers parsed automatically. Default true.

tools.name: list_ai_launches
tools.description: Dated AI model, tool and feature launches from the Kingy AI Launch Tracker, newest first, with categories, launch types, attributes such as open-weight or API-available, the official announcement and the Kingy record.

since.description: Date written as YYYY-MM-DD. Only launches on or after this date.

type.description: Launch type slug, e.g. model-release, feature-update.

tools.name: get_ai_deadlines
tools.description: Model retirement and shutdown dates across direct APIs and cloud platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek), each with certainty, scope, required action, replacement guidance and the official source. Upcoming first.

provider.description: Platform or vendor, e.g. Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic.

query.description: Model id or keyword, e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5.

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: Monthly index of AI prices: median verified API list prices per tier (frontier, mid-range, small) and typical subscription prices, with month-over-month change, constituents and the headline. Optionally the full edition history. CC BY 4.0.

history.description: Include every edition's tier values. Default false.
